name: match-timeline
title: Match timeline
description: The events of a match on a centre line: goals, cards and substitutions with the minute, the player and the side, in one column on a phone.
docs: events are { id, minute, extraMinute?, side, type, player, assist?, detail? } in any order: they are sorted by the clock, and added time reads '45+2'. type is goal, penalty, own-goal, penalty-missed, yellow-card, red-card or substitution, and each has an icon and a word, so it reads without colour (a yellow card is an outlined card, a red one a solid card). The running score is written after every goal, penalty and own goal (an own goal counts for the other side). Home events sit on the left of the line and away events on the right once the timeline itself is 32rem wide (a container query, so it works in a sidebar as well as a page), under the two team names; below that everything runs in one column and each event names its team. status is finished (the default: a labelled 'Half time' break at halfTimeAt, 45 by default, and 'Full time' with the score), live (ending in a pulsing 'Live' that holds still under reduced motion) or scheduled. Goals have a solid icon, the rest a quiet one. It is an ordered list, and each line is read as one sentence in the order minute, event, player, team, score whatever side it sits on ('Minute 45 plus 2, Penalty, Mila Kowalski, Halcyon FC, Score 2 to 1'). For a substitution player is who comes on and detail names who goes off. labels carries every word.
